jobs.occupation: Sales Manager (m/w/d) with Gyrocopter Flight Experience (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
You do not just sell a product, you fly it yourself. At AutoGyro, sales does not end with a conversation, it begins in the air. You present our gyrocopters not only in theory but demonstrate them in flight, making the experience tangible for the customer. You are not selling a generic product, but a high-end aviation product that convinces both emotionally and technically. The key difference is that you do not just show the customer what they are buying, you let them experience it. The role combines sales of our gyrocopters with demonstration flights, is fully on-site and includes travel of approximately 20 to 40 percent. We are looking for an experienced sales professional with a strong affinity for aviation.

Join our dynamic team and play an active part in our company’s success. You can look forward to attractive terms and conditions, as well as a free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Sales of our gyrocopters in direct customer interaction
- Conducting demonstration flights as an integral part of the sales process
- Advising national and international customers
- Managing the entire sales process from first contact to closing
- Representing our brand at customer meetings, events and demonstrations

Requirements

- Valid ultralight pilot license including medical
- Proven practical flight experience, ideally on comparable aircraft
- Ability and willingness to actively fly customers and conduct demonstration flights
- Proven track record in sales of technically complex products
- Fluent German and English skills
- Additional languages such as French are a plus
- Confident and professional appearance with strong personal presence
- Excellent communication and closing skills in an international environment

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

jobs.occupation: Industrial Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) (Supply-Chain-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the Job

The Industrial Supply Chain Manager (I-SCM) is responsible for managing and optimizing the manufacturing and supply chain network to ensure cost-effective, reliable, and scalable production. The role leads industrialization initiatives such as volume ramp-ups, manufacturing transfers, product changes, and supplier and factory onboardings while serving as the Supply Chain Management representative in industrialization projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, the I-SCM ensures that supply chain requirements are fully integrated into project execution, drives capacity and loading strategies across internal and external manufacturing sites, and supports continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply chain performance, efficiency, and resilience.

Your Responsibilities

- Lead Volume Ramp-Up (VRU) activities, manufacturing transfers, supplier and factory onboardings, and product optimization initiatives.
- Represent Supply Chain Management (SCM) in industrialization and Product Change Notification (PCN) projects, ensuring successful implementation and alignment with business objectives.
- Design and implement efficient end-to-end supply chain concepts, including material, capacity, and financial flows across internal and external manufacturing networks.
- Drive capacity planning and loading strategies by balancing internal and external manufacturing resources, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments while optimizing cost, flexibility, capacity utilization, and service levels.
- Establish and lead cross-functional capacity and loading governance processes, including the development and maintenance of planning and loading tools.
- Analyze supply chain, inventory, demand, capacity, and supplier performance data, translating insights into actionable recommendations and management decisions.
- Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and reporting tools to provide transparency, support decision-making, and monitor supply chain performance.
- Identify and drive process improvements across planning, logistics, production, and supply chain operations to enhance efficiency, visibility, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
- Support and improve system-driven processes through master data governance, data validation, process harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Lead or contribute to cross-functional SCM initiatives and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and supply chain optimization.
- Proactively identify supply, capacity, and operational risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure business continuity and supply chain resilience.

Your Profile

- Master Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Manufacturing, or a comparable industry environment.
- Experience working in project-driven and cross-functional environments; exposure to industrialization or manufacturing transfer projects is considered an advantage.
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and collaborate effectively in international organizations.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business decisions.
- High level of ownership, independence, and decision-making capability combined with a hands-on mentality.
- Strong process orientation with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage complex activities in dynamic environments.
- Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications; experience with data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI is an advantage.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build trust-based relationships across all organizational levels.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Core Competencies

- Supply Chain & Capacity Management
- Project & Stakeholder Management
- Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen
- Data Analytics & Performance Reporting
- Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement
- Problem Solving & Decision Making
- Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Communication & Influencing Skills
- Agile Mindset & Change Management
- Attention to Detail & Execution Excellence

jobs.occupation: Equipment Engineer (m/w/d) (Open) (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.

You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment Ownership

- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).
- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.
- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.
- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.

Process and Quality Optimization

- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)
- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)
- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)
- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)
- Yield and Product Quality
- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.
- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.

Project Management

- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.
- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.
- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.

Production Support

- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.
- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.

Other Responsibilities

- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.
- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.
- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.
- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.
- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:

- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering
- Physics
- Materials Science
- Or a comparable technical field

Professional Experience

- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.
- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.

Technical Expertise

- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.
- Experience with MES and ERP systems.
- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.
- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
- High level of initiative and ownership.
- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.
- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
- Continuous Improvement mindset.

Language Skills

- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.
- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.

Supply Chain & Quality Manager - Cabin Seat (f/m/d)

Are You Ready to Define the Passenger Experience? When passengers step onto an Airbus aircraft, the first thing they look for, touch, and experience is their seat. Seating is where cutting-edge aerospace engineering meets customer-facing luxury and strict aviation safety.

We are seeking a high-energy, detail-oriented Supply Chain & Quality Manager (SCQM) to take the lead in managing the quality, compliance, and industrial readiness of our global cabin seating suppliers.

If you are a proactive manager who loves the thrill of fast-paced industrializations, custom designs, and zero-defect executions, this is your ultimate career destination!

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Act as focal point towards the suppliers for operational activities and contract management, and as ambassador of the supplier toward internal functions..
- Perform an effective control of supplier activities, securing a close understanding of the delivery and quality conformity of the product
- Implement recovery, improvement and development plan in order to secure delivery of the products and services in conformity covering quality, delivery.
- Coordinate the stakeholders involved in the supplier operations management and contribute to the corresponding Multi-Functional or Divisional Team (MFT) Manage/contribute to supplier On Quality On Time (OQOT) performance.
- Manage supplier quality Approval/Authorization, ensure that suppliers are compliant with certifications required in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
- Managing suppliers’ quality recoveries and following-up of the quality actions plan of the suppliers via root cause analysis (RCA) 9S / PPS problem solving methodologies

Desired skills and qualifications

Key Skills & Competencies

- Autonomy & Proactivity: High degree of autonomy, initiative, rigor, reactivity, and eagerness to learn
- Stakeholder Management & Collaboration: Strong cross-functional stakeholder management, effective team spirit, and working beyond functional boundaries
- Communication & Negotiation: Excellent communication, negotiation, and persuasion skills with the ability to resolve conflicts constructively
- Problem Solving & Risk Mitigation: Proven track record in solving quality problems, anticipating and mitigating risks, and managing uncertainty across complex scenarios

- Education: Engineering or other relevant technical degree. Professional Experience: At least 4 years of experience, ideally in Quality, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Production
- Domain Background: Industrial background—specifically in Manufacturing Engineering or Quality—is a strong plus. Experience in Cabin perimeter is highly appreciated

Job Description

Nexperia is a global leader in discrete components, logic devices, and MOSFETs. Since the beginning of 2017, the company has operated as an independent organization. Nexperia focuses on efficiency and, drawing on more than half a century of experience, consistently produces reliable semiconductor components in high volumes—100 billion per year. As a Material Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end workflow of high-value, process-critical materials within the Nexperia Hamburg - Materials Management organization. The role ensures compliant handling, accurate tracking, and secure availability of these materials, which are essential for wafer manufacturing operations.

- Coordinate closely with cross-functional stakeholders
- Monitor inventory levels and ensure high data accuracy

Projects & Continuous Improvement:

- Improve material tracking, transparency, and reporting
- Enhance forecasting accuracy and collaboration with external partners
- Support audit readiness and drive process standardization

Key Challenges:

- Managing high-value inventory with minimal variance tolerance
- Ensuring strict compliance in a regulated environment
- Balancing operational efficiency with governance requirements

Stakeholder Environment:

- Collaboration with internal cross-functional teams
- Regular interaction with external partners and service providers

This is you:
A structured and detail-oriented professional with strong analytical skills and a high sense of accountability. The ideal candidate thrives in environments that require precision, compliance awareness, and cross-functional coordination.

Education and Experience:

- Apprenticeship in Logistics, Business, Supply Chain or Material Management.
- 2-5 years in Logistics, Materials Management, Supply-Chain or Manufacturing.
- Preferably experience in the handling/transport of regulated goods.

Hard Skills

MUST have:

- SAP (or comparable ERP) experience in inventory/material management
- Strong data analysis and forecasting skills (Excel or similar tools)
- Fluency in German, both written and spoken

NICE to have:

- Understanding of audit and compliance requirements.

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €18.53 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon.
